title: pkbm-4c-plssem: PLS-SEM analysis code for "Tutor competence as the pathway from learning service quality to 4C skills: Evidence from urban, coastal, and highland community learning centers in Indonesia"
description: Open-source R (seminr) script that reproduces the partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) analysis reported in the F1000Research article: measurement model assessment, full collinearity VIF, structural model (R2, f2, Q2predict), bootstrapping with 5,000 resamples, and mediation analysis. Includes a simulated example dataset; the real data are available from the corresponding author under a data-use agreement.
